Add a theorem-level boundary corollary distinguishing locally constant-rank Gram laws from rank-changing laws, with a worked redundant-message perturbation that verifies the chosen derivative convention.
Make the paper’s positioning more concrete by comparing the analytic simultaneous band numerically and algebraically with the published Causal-MP resampling heuristic on the affine witness.
